mapper.select: SELECT config_id,config_key,config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key=#{key} ORDER BY config_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT config_id,config_key,config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key='vi.config.version' ORDER BY config_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT config_key,config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key IN ('vi.biz.qualification.consent.version','vi.biz.qualification.consent.text') ORDER BY config_key FOR UPDATE
SELECT config_key,config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key IN ('vi.biz.verification.consent.version','vi.biz.verification.consent.text') ORDER BY config_key FOR UPDATE
SELECT config_key,config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key LIKE 'vi.biz.%' ORDER BY config_key,config_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type) SELECT 'vi.config.version','vi.config.version','0','N' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = 'vi.config.version')
mapper.select: SELECT dict_value,dict_label,dict_sort,status FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type=#{dictType} AND status='0' ORDER BY dict_sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_price_rule WHERE vehicle_type_code=#{vehicleTypeCode} AND status='PUBLISHED'
